Toplu taşıma aktarma noktalarında iki fa: Two ways of using a car at public transport transfer points
Sürücülerin kendi araçlarıyla (otomobil,: A system in which drivers come by their own vehicle (car, motorcycle, etc.) to a public transport hub (metro, train or bus terminal), leave the vehicle in the car park there for a long time and finish the journey by public transport.
Şehir merkezine giren araç sayısını azal: To reduce the number of vehicles entering the city centre and to solve parking and traffic jam problems.
Çevre yoluna yakın veya şehir çeperlerin: Large car parks are built next to metro/train stations near the ring road or on the edge of the city. The driver leaves the car in the morning, takes the metro, and picks up the car on the way home in the evening.
Kiss and Ride (K+R) — Öp ve Geç / Bırak: Kiss and Ride (K+R) — Drop and Go
Sürücülerin bir yolcuyu toplu taşıma ist: Special bays or areas where drivers stop only to drop off (or pick up) a passenger at a public transport station; short stops are allowed but long-term parking is not.
İstasyon önlerindeki araç sirkülasyonunu: To organise vehicle movement in front of stations, to prevent congestion and to provide a fast and safe place for passengers to get in and out.
\"Sürücünün yolcuyu araçtan indirmeden ö: It comes from the humorous idea that "the driver kisses the passenger goodbye before they get out of the car" (Kiss & Ride).

Güzelbahçe'de Park and Ride (P+R) Örnekl: Park and Ride (P+R) Examples in Güzelbahçe
Güzelbahçe Vapur İskelesi çevresindeki a: The open car park and bays around the Güzelbahçe Ferry Pier are the most typical local P+R example.
Yelki, Kahramandere veya Çamlı'dan kendi: You drive (by car or motorcycle) from Yelki, Kahramandere or Çamlı down to the coastal road and leave your vehicle in the car park near the ferry pier. Then you take the İZDENİZ ferry to Konak, Alsancak or Karşıyaka and travel without entering city traffic.
Fahrettin Altay Aktarma çevresi: Around the Fahrettin Altay Transfer Centre
Fahrettin Altay Aktarma çevresindeki oto: The car parks around the Fahrettin Altay Transfer Centre are a regional P+R point often used by people travelling from Güzelbahçe to the centre.
Güzelbahçe'den otoyol veya sahil yolu üz: You drive from Güzelbahçe on the motorway or the coastal road to the Üçkuyular/Fahrettin Altay area and leave your car in the multi-storey car park of the transfer centre. You finish the journey by İzmir Metro or tram.
Güzelbahçe'de Kiss and Ride (K+R) Örnekl: Kiss and Ride (K+R) Examples in Güzelbahçe
Güzelbahçe Meydan Mithatpaşa Caddesi üze: The main ESHOT bus bays on Mithatpaşa Caddesi at Güzelbahçe Meydan work as K+R points.
Sabah saatlerinde bir aile ferdini ya da: In the morning you drive a family member or a friend to the main bus stop on Mithatpaşa Caddesi. Without parking, you stop in the drop-off bay for 30 seconds, say goodbye (Kiss & Ride) and drive on. Your passenger then takes an ESHOT bus such as 8/984/321 towards Fahrettin Altay.
Güzelbahçe genelinde (özellikle Seferihi: The "parent drop-off/pick-up bays" in front of colleges and schools across Güzelbahçe (especially on Seferihisar Yolu and in Kahramandere) are among the clearest examples of K+R. Cars do not park; they only drop off or pick up the student and keep moving.
